units.source_text: 到了二月初十之后，朱雀院的三公主于归六条院。

en.t: After the tenth day of the second month had passed, Suzaku In's Third Princess was married into Rokujo In.

units.source_text: 六条院准备迎亲，其隆重异乎寻常。

en.t: Rokujo In prepared to receive the bride with splendor far beyond the ordinary.

units.source_text: 新房设在祝寿时尝新菜的西边的小客厅内。

en.t: The bridal chamber was arranged in the small western sitting room where the new dishes had been tasted during the birthday celebration.

units.source_text: 从第一厢屋、第二厢屋、走廊以至众侍女的房间，布置装饰都很精致。

en.t: From the first side room and the second side room to the corridors and the attendants' quarters, every decoration was exquisitely arranged.

units.source_text: 朱雀院运送妆奁，仿照女御入宫的方式。

en.t: Suzaku In sent the bridal furnishings in a manner modeled on a consort's entrance into the palace.
The magnificence of the ceremonial procession goes without saying.

units.source_text: 送亲人中有许多王侯公卿。

en.t: Among those escorting the bride were many princes, nobles, and high courtiers.

units.source_text: 希望以家臣身份当夫婿的藤大纳言，心中虽然不快，也来参加送亲。

en.t: Fuji Dainagon, who had hoped to become her husband as a retainer, was displeased at heart, yet he too joined the bridal escort.

units.source_text: 三公主的车子到达六条院时，源氏出来迎接，

en.t: When the Third Princess's carriage arrived at Rokujo In, Genji came out to receive her,

units.source_text: 并且亲自扶三公主下车，此乃异乎常例之事。

en.t: and he personally helped the Third Princess down from the carriage, an act quite outside ordinary custom.

units.source_text: 源氏封赠虽然准照太上天皇，但名义上毕竟是个臣下，

en.t: Although Genji's rank and honors were modeled on those of a retired emperor, in name he was still, after all, a subject,

units.source_text: 凡事都有定规，故婚式与女御入宫相异，

en.t: and since everything had its fixed rules, the wedding ceremony differed from a consort's entrance into the palace,

units.source_text: 但又与寻常娶亲不同，这是一对特殊关系的新夫妇。

en.t: yet it was also unlike an ordinary marriage, for this new husband and wife stood in a special relationship.

units.source_text: 婚后三日之内，朱雀院与六条院双方都有高雅、珍贵而风流的赠答。

en.t: During the three days after the wedding, Suzaku In and Rokujo In exchanged gifts and replies that were elegant, precious, and refined.
